core.name: Torin
core.summary: Agentic security in regulated industry, mostly fintech: building the platform agents run on and red teaming them in a sandbox before they reach production.

systems.name: GPT-4o
systems.text: Red teamed the multimodal model for OpenAI's Red Team Network: jailbreaks, prompt injection and multimodal adversarial input. Credited on the system card.

systems.name: Operator
systems.text: Red teamed OpenAI's computer-using agent for prompt injection, jailbreaks and misuse. Credited on the system card.

systems.name: o3-mini
systems.text: Red teamed the reasoning model ahead of release for jailbreaks and misuse. Credited on the system card.

systems.name: Deep Research
systems.text: Red teamed the research agent ahead of release for prompt injection, jailbreaks and misuse. Credited on the system card.

systems.name: Wild West I
systems.text: Out on the GenAI Wild West, Part I: Red Team Redemption. On foundation model red teaming.

systems.name: Wild West II
systems.text: Out on the GenAI Wild West, Part II: The Long Arm of the Law. The second part of the series.

systems.name: Agent runtime
systems.text: Build and operate the runtime AI agents execute on at financial services clients: sandboxed execution, scoped identities and tool permissions, and the SRE work that keeps agent workloads observable and recoverable on Kubernetes.

systems.name: AI Security training
systems.text: Author and lead ControlPlane's AI Security training. The agent sandboxing content was built with Docker, who sponsored the 2026 North America roadshow, starting in Toronto and New York.

systems.name: A Game of Ethics
systems.text: Branching-scenario ethics evals for LLM agents. Co-founded it and presented it at KubeCon NA 2026 (Cloud Native AI + Inference Day).

systems.name: DynastAI
systems.text: A reinforcement learning demo using GRPO.

systems.name: FINOS AI Governance
systems.text: Contributor to the FINOS AI Governance Framework, which covers risks and controls for AI adoption in financial services.

systems.name: FINOS AI Readiness
systems.text: Co-authored the FINOS AI readiness work for regulated industry.

systems.name: AI Governance Framework
systems.text: Open source AI governance framework.

systems.name: VEX remediation
systems.text: Scanners produce more findings than any team can triage. I operationalize VEX so a finding comes with a statement about whether it's exploitable in that build, then use agentic remediation and sandboxed red teaming to work the ones that are.

systems.name: Argo CD threat model
systems.text: Co-authored the end user threat model for Argo CD with the maintainers: a multi-tenant deployment across clusters, attack trees for each exploit path, and prioritized recommendations.

systems.name: Repo-server RCE
systems.text: An unauthenticated RCE in Argo CD's repo-server. The attack chain maps to findings ATM-014, ATM-015 and ATM-017 from the threat model. Internal does not mean isolated.

systems.name: Envoy Gateway threat model
systems.text: Built a multi-tenant cluster with Envoy Gateway implementing the Gateway API, threat modeled it from the end user's deployment, and worked with the maintainers to push fixes upstream.

systems.name: EKS at Citi
systems.text: Security architecture and engineering for EKS in a regulated environment.

systems.name: SPIFFE and SPIRE
systems.text: Courseware on building Zero Trust networks with SPIFFE/SPIRE, Envoy, OPA, OIDC and Kubernetes, with hands-on labs and threat-driven analysis of each design.

systems.name: Intro to Zero Trust
systems.text: The introductory Zero Trust course for the Linux Foundation, companion to LFS482.

systems.name: High assurance at NIST
systems.text: Takeaways on Zero Trust and high assurance from the NIST Multi-Cloud and OSCAL conferences.
